Poplar Grove is a rural settlement in Prince County in the Canadian province of Prince Edward Island. It is located approximately  northwest of Summerside and about  southeast of Alberton.
It is the birthplace of Joshua Gordon MacArthur (1911–1980), a carpenter, farmer, and Liberal politician who served in the Legislative Assembly of Prince Edward Island from 1970 to 1976.
